issue_context.title: Z-index transformations should disregard deleted elements
issue_context.body:
Changing element's z-index changes its index in the `elements` array, but it doesn't ignore `isDeleted` elements.

Consider elements:

```
[ A, B, C, D, E ]
```

If you delete `B, C, D`, and then select `E` and move it one layer down, visually it doesn't change anything because it moves it behind deleted element `D`, and so on.

It should skip deleted elements and move behind `A`.

review_comments: Removed because it was used only by z-index manip and no longer used as of now.
